1.
We are the band that performs first. We need two helpers to carry our cases.

2.
Please bring the guitar which has the blue case. The other one needs a repair.

3.
The comedy is free, but please reserve a seat at the office.

4.
I did not perform, but I helped a boy find his drawing. I feel pleased about that.

5.
Pupils who perform first must arrive at five. Everyone else can come at half past five.
